/current-affairs/india-s-health-transiti.title: India’s Health Transition: Rising Life Expectancy, Persistent Health Gaps and the NCD Burden | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/india-s-health-transiti.description: India’s health profile is undergoing a major transition, marked by rising life expectancy, persistent regional health inequalities and a growing burden of non-communicable diseases. The article examines changes in life expectancy, HALE, disease patterns and India’s evolving public-health challenges.

/current-affairs/what-happened-on-the-fl.title: WHAT HAPPENED ON THE FLYDUBAI AIRCRAFT | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/what-happened-on-the-fl.description: The article examines the in-flight altercation aboard a flydubai flight, the emergency response, diversion to Saudi Arabia, and the role of crew and passengers in ensuring a safe landing. It also highlights concerns surrounding aviation security, unlawful interference, emergency protocols, and international coordination in civil aviation.

/current-affairs/beyond-cleanliness-the-.title: Beyond Cleanliness: The Women and Transgender Changemakers of Swachhata | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/beyond-cleanliness-the-.description: The article highlights how women and transgender persons are transforming Swachhata into a pathway for livelihoods, dignity and social inclusion. Through innovative waste management, community participation and inclusive sanitation initiatives, these changemakers demonstrate how cleanliness can drive sustainable and equitable development.

/current-affairs/from-invisible-work-to-.title: From “Invisible Work” to “Measurable Work” | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/from-invisible-work-to-.description: The article explores how unpaid household and care work, often overlooked in economic statistics, contributes significantly to human capital, family welfare and the wider economy. It highlights the Supreme Court’s recognition of “loss of domestic care” as a distinct compensable contribution, marking a shift from “invisible work” to measurable economic value.

/current-affairs/upsc-at-100-a-century-o.title: UPSC at 100: A Century of Public Service and Nation-Building | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/upsc-at-100-a-century-o.description: The article traces the 100-year institutional journey of the UPSC, from its establishment in 1926 to its present status as an independent constitutional body. It highlights the Commission’s role in recruitment, examinations, government advice and public-service administration, and its contribution to nation-building over a century.

/current-affairs/nerve-agents.title: Nerve Agents | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/nerve-agents.description: Nerve agents are highly toxic chemical warfare agents that disrupt the nervous system by interfering with acetylcholine regulation. The article examines their mechanism, major types, health effects, international controls and challenges in preventing chemical-weapons misuse.

/current-affairs/ai-nomics.title: AI-NOMICS | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/ai-nomics.description: The article explores how AI is transforming economic activity through tokenisation, AI-driven productivity, digital finance and emerging business models. It examines the growing economic significance of AI, including its impact on markets, jobs, investment, innovation and financial systems.

/current-affairs/beyond-the-label-food-s.title: Beyond the Label: Food Safety, Celebrity Endorsements and the Fight for Consumer Health | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/beyond-the-label-food-s.description: The article examines how food labels, misleading advertisements and celebrity endorsements influence consumer choices and public health. It highlights the role of food-safety regulation and accountability in protecting consumers.

/current-affairs/elephant-deaths.title: Elephant Deaths | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/elephant-deaths.description: Human–elephant conflict in Kerala is intensifying due to habitat intrusion, crop raiding and human-induced threats such as electrocution and explosives. The article examines elephant mortality hotspots and highlights the need for effective wildlife conservation and conflict mitigation measures.

/current-affairs/indo-japan-japan-s-key-.title: Indo-Japan: Japan’s Key Agenda | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/indo-japan-japan-s-key-.description: The article explores the evolving India–Japan strategic partnership, highlighting key areas of cooperation in trade, investment, semiconductors, technology and supply chain resilience. It examines Japan’s role in India’s development priorities and the importance of strengthening bilateral ties in the Indo-Pacific region.

/current-affairs/the-arctic-race.title: THE ARCTIC RACE | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/the-arctic-race.description: The article explores the growing strategic importance of Greenland in the Arctic and the United States’ expanding interest in the region. It examines the geopolitical, security, economic and resource dimensions shaping the evolving US–Greenland relationship.

/current-affairs/the-houthis-and-the-red.title: The Houthis and the Red Sea Crisis: Regional Conflict, Maritime Security and Implications for India | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/the-houthis-and-the-red.description: The article examines the Houthis’ role in the Yemen conflict, their attacks on Red Sea shipping and the resulting regional security challenges. It also explores the implications for India’s maritime security, international trade routes, energy supplies and strategic interests.

/current-affairs/battle-of-haifa-1918-in.title: Battle of Haifa (1918): Indian Valour, Imperial Legacy and the Politics of Historical Memory | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/battle-of-haifa-1918-in.description: The Battle of Haifa (1918) highlights the courage and contribution of Indian soldiers during the First World War and its lasting place in India’s military history. It also explores the contrasting memories of India, Israel and Palestine, revealing the complex legacy of colonial warfare, liberation and historical remembrance.

/current-affairs/urban-waste-management-.title: Urban Waste Management and Legacy Dumpsite Remediation | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/urban-waste-management-.description: India’s urban waste-management efforts are shifting from conventional dumping towards scientific legacy dumpsite remediation, resource recovery and sustainable land use under SBM-U 2.0. Case studies from Gorakhpur, Bhalswa, Nagpur and Raichur highlight how reclaimed dumpsites can become eco-parks, processing facilities and ecological spaces.

/current-affairs/why-apple-faces-ccpa-pr.title: Why Apple Faces CCPA Probe over User-Rights Issue | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/why-apple-faces-ccpa-pr.description: The CCPA’s probe into Apple examines whether software-related issues and warranty exclusions could unfairly shift repair costs onto consumers. The case highlights consumer rights, warranty obligations and regulation of unfair trade practices.

/current-affairs/chronic-kidney-disease-.title: Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Origin: Uddanam Nephropathy | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/chronic-kidney-disease-.description: This article examines Uddanam Nephropathy (CKDu), a chronic kidney disease of unknown origin affecting agricultural communities in Andhra Pradesh. It explores the possible links with heat stress, dehydration, environmental exposure and other factors, along with similar kidney diseases reported globally.

/current-affairs/grey-hounds.title: Grey Hounds | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/grey-hounds.description: Grey Hounds is an elite counter-insurgency force established to combat Left-Wing Extremism through specialized jungle warfare, intelligence and rapid operations. The article examines its evolution, organizational structure, operational role and contribution to India’s internal security framework.

/current-affairs/india-s-path-to-blue-sk.title: India’s Path to Blue Skies: From Awareness to Action for Cleaner Air | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/india-s-path-to-blue-sk.description: India’s clean-air strategy combines monitoring, NCAP, digital tracking, sector-wise pollution control, green initiatives, and coordinated governance to achieve cleaner air and healthier communities.

/current-affairs/upi-merchant-discount-r.title: UPI Merchant Discount Rate (MDR): Will It Affect UPI Usage? | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/upi-merchant-discount-r.description: The reintroduction of the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on select UPI transactions has raised questions about its impact on digital payment usage. This article examines the scope of MDR, its implications for merchants and users, and its role in strengthening the UPI ecosystem and digital payments infrastructure.

/current-affairs/how-india-became-a-majo.title: How India Became a Major Destination for Wild Animals | Akella Raghavendra's e-Gurukulam for IAS
/current-affairs/how-india-became-a-majo.description: Explore why India has emerged as a major destination for international wildlife imports, particularly for zoos and captive conservation facilities. Understand the UPSC relevance through **CITES, wildlife trade, ex-situ conservation, animal welfare, and India’s regulatory framework**.

/current-affairs/digital-india-bhashini-.description: Explore how BHASHINI uses Language AI to promote multilingual digital inclusion, empower innovators, and strengthen India–Nepal cooperation in language technology and inclusive digital solutions.
